final_answer.key_evidence_summary: Only outlier in boutique: pod recommendationservice-68d8957488-2l4kj is 0/1 Running (READY False, Ready False, ContainersReady False) while all other 10 pods are 1/1; Restart Count 0 and app logs show a healthy server ('listening on port: 8080'). Pod events carry the mechanism: 'Warning Unhealthy 3s (x10 over 83s) kubelet Readiness probe failed: Get "http://172.20.2.107:8080/": net/http: HTTP/1.x transport connection broken: malformed HTTP response "\x00\x00\x1e\x04\x00..."' — the payload is an HTTP/2 SETTINGS frame, proving the HTTP/1.x GET probe hits a gRPC-only port. GetAppYAML confirms the mismatch: readinessProbe.httpGet path=/ port=8080 on recommendationservice:8080 gRPC, while livenessProbe correctly uses grpc port 8080 (hence container is never killed, Restart Count 0). Consequence: Endpoints for recommendationservice is empty (<none>), so the service is drained from callers. Port 8080 is correct (containerPort and Service port/targetPort all 8080, grpc liveness succeeds), so the defect is the readiness probe protocol, not the port or timing.
